rawContent: Ochan @NaomiOsaka pou kouraj, pou respè eritaj nou, pou volonte politik. Ochan paske w rekonèt zanset yo kòm sous libète. #BlackLivesMatter -> #RespekteNou  #BreonnaTaylor #ElijaMcClain #AhmaudArbery #TrayvonMartin #GeorgeFloyd #PhilandoCastile #TamirRice  https://t.co/9hWbbaqyCt

@SorayaMcDonald Thank you @SorayaMcDonald for asking @naomiosaka that question about social justice—during interview after the final. Thank you @naomiosaka for connecting #BlackLivesMatter to Haitian history where #BlackLivesMatter started long before there were hashtags  https://t.co/7Tst2qfLNb

@SorayaMcDonald Yes, Haiti is where #BlackLivesMatter started—in 1791 sans hashtags. @NaomiOsaka understands that—more than most. At @MIT @MIT_SHASS most of my students know about US & French revolutions but not the *REAL* revolution of Haiti that made *ALL* lives matter  https://t.co/9hWbbaqyCt

@TheUndefeated @SorayaMcDonald I also like the fact that thanks to @SorayaMcDonald's interview question @naomiosaka got to link the Haitian revolution to the #BlackLivesMatter movement.  This is important because too few of us knows about the Haitian revolution where #BlackLivesMatter started in 1791 already.

Thank you @SorayaMcDonald for this article as well — on @NoamiOsaka's support of #BlackLivesMatter which she so insightfully links to the history of the Haitian Revolution where #BlackLivesMatter started, sans hashtags, in the Americas, in 1791 already!  https://t.co/O6CQn2HtUI
